info.name: Recycle Bin
info.description:
The Recycle Bin screen: four tabs (All Items · Deleted by Me · Team Credentials · Expiring Soon), each with Normal Vault and Critical Vault sub-tabs and their counts; the retention period (Normal changeable, Critical fixed at 30 days); restore and delete (Critical Vault items: the Branch Admin only); Empty Bin for both vaults in one call.

BEFORE YOU START
Fill baseUrl, email/password (an employee with Credentials Vault → View), branchEmail/branchPassword (the Branch Admin of that employee's branch) and adminEmail/adminPassword (a client admin). Run the folders in order: 00 → 05.

Full details: docs/CREDVAULT_VAULTS_API_SHEET.md → Recycle Bin.

02 · GET /recycle-bin — list, 4 tabs × Normal / Critical, counts

exec: pm.test('counts: both vaults × 4 tabs + total', () => { ['normal', 'critical', 'total'].forEach(v => pm.expect(b.counts[v]).to.include.keys('all', 'mine', 'team', 'soon')); pm.expect(b.counts.total.all).to.eql(b.counts.normal.all + b.counts.critical.all); });
pm.test('7 days or less left', () => b.data.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.days_left).to.be.at.most(7)));

item.name: 03 · GET | PUT /recycle-bin/retention — Change period
item.description:
GET /recycle-bin/retention — the Change period popup: normal {days, options, can_change}, critical {days: 30, fixed: true, can_change: false}.
PUT /recycle-bin/retention { days: 7|15|30|60|90, vault?: normal } — Vault Admins, Normal Vault only. A shorter period deletes the items already past it, right away (the popup's note). The Critical Vault keeps a fixed 30 days: a change is refused.

item.name: 04 · POST /recycle-bin/{id}/restore · DELETE /recycle-bin/{id}
item.description:
POST /recycle-bin/{id}/restore — back to its vault (My Vault, Team Vault or Critical Vault).
DELETE /recycle-bin/{id} { confirm: true } — gone for good.
A Critical Vault item: the Branch Admin of its branch only — anyone else gets 403 "Only the Branch Admin can restore or delete Critical Vault items in the Recycle Bin."

exec: pm.test('back in My Vault', () => pm.expect(b.data.restored_to).to.eql('My Vault'));

exec: pm.test('back in the Critical Vault', () => pm.expect(b.data.restored_to).to.eql('Critical Vault'));

item.name: Restore it again — no longer in the bin (404)
05 · DELETE /recycle-bin — Empty Bin (Normal + Critical)
item.description:
DELETE /recycle-bin { confirm: true, vault?: all|normal|critical } — vault all (default) empties both vaults at once: every Normal Vault item the caller sees in the bin, and — for the Branch Admin — every Critical Vault item of the branch. Critical items anyone else sees are left and counted in data.skipped.critical.
Response data: deleted {normal, critical, total}, skipped {critical, reason}.

⚠ This deletes for good EVERYTHING the caller may delete in the bin — not only the test items. Run it on test data.
